{{Quote|The Imperial ship's about to ''land!'' We've got to do something.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="PATR" />}}
An '''unidentified Imperial fighter craft''' was used by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Keeper's World)|commander]] and four [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to pursue a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Leia Organa's Rebel scout craft|scout craft]] to the surface of [[Keeper's World]] during the [[Battle of The Keeper's World]].

==Description==
{{Quote|We've just been ''spotted''-- by a fighter craft from the Imperial fleet!|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="AMOM" />}}
The shape of the exterior of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fighter craft was identical to that of the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], with two broad [[Solar collector/Legends|solar panels]] on either side of a ball-shaped hull. However, the ship was much larger, allowing it to transport four passengers, plus one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="PATR" />

==History==
{{Quote|Commander-- we have finally ''located'' the unidentified starship which ''escaped'' our tractor-beams before.|Imperial Navy trooper|<ref name="DD">{{StoryCite|story=Dread Discovery!|book=Pizzazz 3}}</ref>}}
The [[Battle of The Keeper's World]] began in space, but the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Leia Organa's Rebel scout craft|scout craft]] piloted by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] soon crashed on the planet below.<ref name="UPSWS2">{{StoryCite|story=Untitled Pizzazz 2 comic|book=Pizzazz 2|sformatted=Untitled comic}}</ref> After discovering the wreckage, the Imperial [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Keeper's World)|commander]] boarded an Imperial fighter craft with a complement of four [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to pursue the Rebels.<ref name="DD" /> One of the stormtroopers [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the craft.<ref name="PATR" />

After [[The Keeper]] sent her planet into cataclysmic uproar, the commander and his stormtroopers retreated back to the fighter craft and escaped the planet, returning to the fleet.<ref name="TFF">{{StoryCite|story=The Final Fury!|book=Pizzazz 9}}</ref>

==Commanders and crew==
{{Quote|Stormtroopers! Stand by to land on the unidentified planet below!|Imperial commander|<ref name="PATR" />}}
The Imperial fighter craft was commanded by an unidentified Imperial commander during the Battle of The Keeper's World.<ref name="PATR" /> The ship also carried a complement of four stormtroopers, all of whom survived to retreat from the planet after the battle.<ref name="TFF" />
